Metadata.Goal: 从 spl-bun 生产与测试 surface 退出旧 organization-adjustment 业务，只保留通用平台与历史证据。
Metadata.Description: 删除旧业务 bundle、production registration、业务测试和 UI 期待；不删除通用 timeline/operation/runtime/server/workbench 能力或 Codument 归档。

TaskSpace.name: retire-organization-adjustment-business-domain
TaskSpace.Description: 先冻结保留边界，再移除业务实现/注册/期待，最后做双项目 clean ownership 验证。

TaskGroup.name: Retirement Contract
TaskGroup.Description: 冻结只保留 event/commerce reference bundles 与通用平台能力。

Task.name: Define removal and preservation matrix
Task.Description: 列明业务源、exports、registration、tests/e2e 与 behavior 删除，同时保护通用 packages、generic Workbench 和 Codument archive。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 生产 reference composition 精确只含 event-operations-lifecycle 与 commerce-operations
通用 contracts/runtime/server/workbench 与历史目录不被删除

TaskGroup.name: Legacy Business Removal
TaskGroup.Description: 移除旧业务 owner 及其生产/测试接线。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 生产源码和 build dist 不再包含 organization-adjustment
production server 仍通过 generic registration 组合两个 reference bundles

Task.name: Remove business tests and UI expectations
Task.Description: 删除业务专属 domain tests 和 Workbench/server e2e expectations，保留通用 temporal UI 测试。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 无旧业务 fixture/preset/route 的正向测试期待
generic catalog/request/response/timeline UI regression 仍 PASS

TaskGroup.name: Ownership Convergence
TaskGroup.Description: 完整回归并核对 host/platform ownership split。

Task.name: Run platform and residue verification
Task.Description: 运行 build/typecheck/tests、production startup/catalog、source/dist residue scan 和 host boundary tests。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: spl-bun build/test/typecheck 与两 reference bundles HTTP replay PASS
Holon 业务只在 host，platform 无 Holon/旧 organization 业务实现且历史证据仍在
